gloss: to divide into smaller portions; to portion out

definitions.gloss: to divide into smaller portions; to portion out; to subdivide
definitions.explanation: To divide something (typically food, goods, or quantities) into smaller, more manageable portions. Very common in cooking, food storage, and distribution contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧にして⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To portion the meat and freeze it.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧にして⟦{配|くば}った→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: I divided the snacks into small portions and handed them out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧にした⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{経済的|けいざいてき}→経済的：05675_keizaiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's more economical to buy in bulk and divide it into smaller portions.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{小|こ}→小〜：00240_ko⟧ (small) + {分|わ}け (dividing/sharing). Very common in daily life, especially when talking about food preparation and storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to divide into smaller portions
- ⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧にして⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to portion and freeze
- ⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: individually packaged portions
- ⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧{袋|ぶくろ}: small portion bags

USAGE:
Most often appears as ⟦{小分|こわ}け→小分け：18689_kowake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ rather than {小分|こわ}けする. The ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ form is more natural in everyday speech.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide/separate — more general
- ⟦{取|と}り{分|わ}ける→取り分ける：22512_toriwakeru⟧: to take one's share; to dish out — implies distributing among people
- ⟦{切|き}り{分|わ}ける→切り分ける：11774_kiriwakeru⟧: to cut and divide — implies cutting
